stable.notes: Meeting sync lists each meeting and where it is: its start time and its stage (HQ polish with a percent, saving to the library, or waiting), the one being worked on first. HQ prefill reads Ready between recordings. Pairs with server 6.50.4.

notice.title: Queued messages open and edit
notice.body: Tap a queued row on the pet card to read the whole message. Edit puts it in the field; Return replaces it in the queue, Escape keeps it as it was. The Sessions composer has Edit and Replace. With more than one waiting, the edited message goes to the back of the line, and Control says so. A message the session already has cannot be recalled.
